memory_update.text: Use Pearson and Grand Canyon Education as the reference anchors for this node; they validate that licensure testing, credentials, simulation, and VR are the scarce layers, not generic courseware.
Stride/MedCerts is a legitimate underfollowed discovery name because its public disclosure explicitly combines healthcare certification, virtual simulations, and AI-enabled training.

node: Simulation, VR, AI certificates, licensure-prep, and credentialing tools for regulated professions
summary: Public-market exposure clusters around two chokepoints: regulated exam/testing infrastructure and credential-rich workforce training platforms. The clearest anchor is Pearson VUE/Certiport as licensure and certification infrastructure. Grand Canyon Education and Stride/MedCerts show that healthcare and career education operators are explicitly buying simulation, VR, and AI-enhanced training capacity. Coursera is the smaller-cap discovery name: its AI/professional-certificate and verified-learning platform makes it the most underfollowed public exposure in this node.
